findings.problem: The 'no repeat' weekday profile does not turn the cantor's Areshet repeat off. The output still prints the reader's second Areshet, wrapped in an unresolved j:conditional with the Codex rubric. The weekday_repeat_yes output resolves correctly at lines 2084-2110. So the gate fails in only one direction, and the 'no repeat' custom (ויש שאין הש״ץ חוזר) cannot be produced on a weekday. Likely cause: the outer any() has two branches not tied to the day: rite frankfurt_am_main=true and practice musaf-shabbat-responses=both_cantor_repeat. A weekday profile reasonably leaves the Shabbat-only symbol unset and may leave Frankfurt unset. Then any(undecided, undecided, false) stays undecided, even though musaf-areshet-cantor-repeat=false. Reviewer's inference from the emitted XML; the compiler was not run and the profile was not seen.
